categories.main_business_segments: China CITIC Financial Asset Management Co., Ltd. primarily operates in distressed asset management, which is its core business, and asset management and investment. The distressed asset management segment includes acquisition and disposal of distressed debt assets, debt-to-equity swaps, restructuring, equity investment, special bond investment, and distressed asset-based property development. The asset management and investment segment covers international business and other financial investments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs competitive bidding, public auctions, blind auctions, and negotiated acquisitions to acquire distressed debt assets. It uses professional pricing, disposal, restructuring, debt-to-equity swaps, asset restructuring, business restructuring, and equity investment to manage and enhance asset value. The company also leverages digital transformation, artificial intelligence, and a high-quality research system to support investment decisions and risk management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves financial institutions including large commercial banks, joint stock commercial banks, city and rural commercial banks, non-banking financial institutions, and non-financial enterprises. It also supports state-owned enterprises, small and medium-sized financial institutions, real estate enterprises, and strategic emerging industries. The company’s services are aligned with national strategies and regional economic development initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: China CITIC Financial Asset Management operates across 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in mainland China, as well as in Hong Kong and Macau. It has 33 branches and multiple subsidiaries covering major economic regions such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei area, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and western and northeastern China. The company also conducts international business through its overseas subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the financial asset management supply chain. It acquires distressed assets from upstream financial institutions and non-financial enterprises, manages and restructures these assets, and disposes or invests in them to realize value. It also provides asset management services and investment products to clients, acting as an intermediary and asset manager.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on consolidating its core business of distressed asset management, enhancing capabilities in acquisition and disposal, M&A and restructuring, equity investment, and special bond investment. It emphasizes building high-quality research and specialized marketing systems, digital transformation, artificial intelligence applications, and risk management innovation. The company aims to improve asset quality, optimize asset structure, and deepen integration with CITIC Group’s industry and finance resources.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through income from distressed debt assets, fair value changes on distressed debt and other financial assets, interest income, gains from derecognition of financial assets, commission and fee income, dividend income, and net gains on disposals of subsidiaries, associates, and joint ventures. The company also earns income from asset management services and investment returns from equity and bond investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China CITIC Financial Asset Management is one of the four major state-owned financial asset management companies in China, positioning itself as a leading player in distressed asset management. It competes with other AMCs such as China Great Wall Asset Management, China Orient Asset Management, and China Cinda Asset Management. The company leverages its affiliation with CITIC Group and its comprehensive service capabilities to maintain a strong market position and industry benchmark status.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, the company reported total assets of approximately RMB984.3 billion and total equity of RMB49.8 billion. Revenue for 2024 was RMB112.8 billion, a 60% increase year-on-year, with net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB9.62 billion, 5.4 times the previous year. The company has shown steady asset growth, improved profitability, and enhanced capital adequacy with a capital adequacy ratio of 15.69% and a leverage ratio of 10.1:1.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its role as a national stabilizer and financial risk mitigator, leveraging its state-owned background and integration with CITIC Group’s industry and finance resources. It offers comprehensive distressed asset management solutions, combining acquisition, restructuring, disposal, and investment capabilities. Its unique value lies in professional pricing, risk control, innovative financial products, and a synergistic ecosystem that supports high-quality economic development and financial stability.
